from: .nw-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(300px, 1fr)); gap: 10px; }
to: .nw-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(400px, 1fr)); gap: 10px; }

from: #flyout-install-facts dd { text-align: right; min-width: 0; overflow-wrap: anywhere; user-select: text; }
.empty-state-centered { grid-column: 1 / -1; display: grid; place-items: center; gap: 14px; text-align: center; padding: 70px 20px; color: var(--soft); }
